product_one_liner.value: Scandit provides AI-powered smart data capture that reads barcodes, text, objects and IDs on smart devices to automate enterprise frontline workflows and improve customer experiences.

pricing_page.notes: The public page describes fixed and flexible pricing options.

eng_blog.notes: Two technical posts by CTO and co-founder Christian Floerkemeier explain the AI engine's shared models and codebase, and ShelfView's cloud-processing and computer-vision pipeline.

public_docs.notes: Public developer documentation includes installation, system requirements and migration guides.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Senior Machine Learning Engineer (Biometrics & Face Recognition), Tampere.

model_provider.notes: Scandit names its own vision-AI engine, which powers barcode scanning, ID verification and shelf intelligence.

compliance_certs.notes: ISO 27001:2022 certified; GDPR compliance is claimed, rather than a GDPR certification.

last_funding.notes: Announced February 9, 2022; led by Warburg Pincus.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest disclosed funding round was February 2022, before the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Business Development Representative — French Speaker; posting first published October 27, 2026.

launched_6mo.notes: Announced Self-Checkout Loss Prevention, a real-time vision-AI solution for retailers, on September 15, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Tom Karrat's profile lists his start as Scandit's Chief Revenue Officer in January 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Sales job postings name these systems; the BDR posting explicitly requires maintaining Salesforce.
